newsitem.title: USA: Community Federal sets special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Community Federal sets special dividend.

text.p: Community Federal Bancorp Inc said Monday it set a one-time special cash dividend of $2.50 a share, but the company's fiscal year earnings will be hurt from the sale of securities to fund the payout.

"There will be a slight reduction in the company's earnings for the fiscal year ending September 30, 1997 due to losses that will be recognized upon the liquidation of securities to fund this cash dividend," the company said in a statement.
Community Federal said the dividend will be payable May 30, 1997 to shareholders of record as of May 16, 1997.
The company said the dividend is a "wise" use of a portion of the large amount of capital raised in its conversion stock offering.
